brief: Original voice for a thumb-sized felt troll. Gender-neutral, young-sounding but not a baby. Bright, slightly breathy, soft fuzzy edges. High pitch, like a warm adult voice raised five to seven semitones with small-creature formants. Quick and bouncy, sing-song rises at phrase ends, giggles easily. No accent. Dry studio recording, no reverb.
